name: Math Blob Run
author: Unity Play
description:
A Game In which a Bad Blob is chasing Our Math Blob and the Only thing that can Save our Math Blob is Solving Mental Math Questions Fast . 
🔵A tool which unites Math Calculations with a fun game.
🔵This Game is For those who wants to Practice fast calculations in a Fun way.
Game Features.
1. Simple and intuitive Game Play.
2.1000+ Math questions of all Kinds.
3. Retro sound-effects.
4. Colorful Graphics. 

Game Rules-
1. Total 3 lives.
2. 3 consecutive Wrong answers will end the game.
3. Every Correct answer adds 1 live.
4. Answering consecutive right answers will increase blob speed.
